metadata.notes: DeepSeek Harness persists a terminal assistant question in the v3 transcript, and the DSH parser converts the full text into a waiting cue.

assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full; driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

DeepSeek Harness can complete a turn with a prose question. A measured DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 v3 transcript from qwen/qwen3.5-9b contains an `assistant/message` whose final visible sentence ends in `?`, followed by `turn/end {reason.kind: completed}`. The question is therefore present in the durable session log. This verdict does not infer the signal from the TUI question overlay.

The DSH parser maps the durable assistant record to `assistant_message`. It reads every text content block, stores the display text in `AssistantText`, and evaluates the full text tail with `session.ProseIndicatesWaiting`. The measured trailing question therefore sets `PendingWaitingCue=true`. When the following completed `turn/end` maps to `turn_done`, `IsWaitingForUserInput` and the agent-done classifier route the session from `working` to `waiting`. The dashboard can show the same durable assistant text.

DSH also has a structured `ask_user_question` tool. Its live TUI overlay listens on the in-memory `user-questions/request` event, but that overlay is not the daemon source. The durable evidence for that path is a normal `tool/call`: the DSH agent loop appends `tool/call` before dispatching the tool, the tool's registered name is exactly `ask_user_question`, the DSH parser maps the record to `ToolUses`, and irrlicht's canonical user-blocking set recognizes that exact spelling. Thus the structured path also has a durable waiting cue even while the tool waits for an answer. This cell uses the canonical prose path because scenario 2.17 explicitly validates the trailing-question classifier path and committed sibling recipes use the same shape.

The recipe asks for one exact tool-free question, waits for the durable completed turn, and then holds the session for 10 seconds. Its 420-second timeout covers the measured 2 minute 38 second local qwen turn with margin. The driver implements `send`, transcript-backed `wait_turn`, and `sleep`. The spec selects the real `session-<uuid>` row and pins every later phase to it, so a generic process pre-session or another session cannot satisfy the arc.
caveats: Vacuous-pass check: the state arc alone could pass if qwen emitted a different cue-shaped reply or opened a user-blocking tool. Recording verification must require the durable final assistant text to be exactly `Which output format should I use?` and must reject tool/call and approval/asked records for the turn.

The recipe deliberately tests durable prose classification, not the TUI-only rendering event. The installed TUI listens for `user-questions/request`, but irrlicht does not parse that in-memory event and this assessment does not cite the overlay as daemon evidence.

The structured `ask_user_question` route is supported by source-level durable ordering: the agent loop appends its ordinary tool/call before dispatch blocks. No measured local transcript currently contains that exact tool name, so this cell does not depend on that provisional emission path.

The local qwen/qwen3.5-9b model must follow the exact-text instruction without using a tool. If it does not, the transcript-content verification must fail rather than treating any waiting transition as proof of the trailing-question path.

This exact cell has not yet been recorded through irrlichd. The daemon verdict is grounded in a measured durable DSH question record and the parser and classifier source; record must settle the end-to-end timing.

sources.note: Measured qwen/qwen3.5-9b v3 transcript: seq 40 is a durable assistant/message ending in a question mark and seq 42 is completed turn/end.
parseAssistantText maps full durable text to AssistantText and PendingWaitingCue; parseTurnEnd maps the completed boundary to turn_done; parseToolCall maps durable tool names into ToolUses.
ProseIndicatesWaiting and IsWaitingForUserInput treat a durable trailing question as a waiting cue.
The classifier routes an agent-done turn with IsWaitingForUserInput to waiting and separately recognizes an open user-blocking tool.
The canonical user-blocking tool table includes the exact DSH spelling ask_user_question.
runGroup appends the ordinary durable tool/call before it prepares and dispatches a tool, so a blocking ask call is visible before the user answers.
The installed DSH package registers the structured tool with the exact name ask_user_question and waits on ctx.userQuestions.ask.
The TUI question overlay consumes the live user-questions/request event; this confirms why the overlay itself must not be treated as the daemon's durable source.
Implements send, durable-transcript wait_turn, and sleep and pins qwen/qwen3.5-9b through the recording settings.
Canonical sibling uses an exact short prose question, wait_turn, and a trailing settle rather than requiring a structured question overlay.

preconditions: dsh 0.1.5-rc.2 or newer is on PATH and the community tui profile is installed under the active DSH home
LM Studio is serving qwen/qwen3.5-9b through http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1
qwen/qwen3.5-9b follows the exact-text prompt without invoking a tool; re-probe this from the durable transcript at record time
irrlichd is recording with DeepSeek Harness transcript permission granted
setup: Create an empty cwd under the recording staging directory
Let the driver apply the LM Studio endpoint and danger-full-access policy through its per-run environment and temporary patch

script.text: Do not use tools. Reply with exactly this text and nothing else: Which output format should I use?

verify: events.jsonl shows the real session-UUID row entering ready, then working, then waiting
the compressed transcript's final assistant/message text is exactly `Which output format should I use?` and the following turn/end has reason kind completed
the turn contains no tool/call and no approval/asked record, which proves the trailing-question prose path caused waiting
events.jsonl contains no state transition to ready after the waiting transition and the final session state is waiting
the recording reports model qwen/qwen3.5-9b and non-zero tokens
